reason: Term "or his delegate" defined one way for Secretary of Treasury and similarly-construed way for any other US official, selected by which official is referenced.
ocaml:
let meaning_of_delegate_secretary (ref_official : official) : delegate =
  (* 7701(a)(12)(A)(i) : delegate — any officer, employee, or agency of Treasury Department duly authorized directly or by redelegation to perform function *)
  authorized_treasury_officer_employee_or_agency ref_official

let meaning_of_delegate_other (ref_official : official) : delegate =
  (* 7701(a)(12)(A)(ii) : delegate — similarly construed for other US officials *)
  authorized_official_employee_or_agency ref_official

let meaning_of_delegate (ref_official : official) : delegate =
  if refers_to_secretary_of_treasury ref_official then
    meaning_of_delegate_secretary ref_official
  else
    meaning_of_delegate_other ref_official
